clips.title: The story
paras: On the wreck of the Intrepid, Captain Halyndor still guards the key to his strongbox. The rusted iron key once kept a mysterious item locked away aboard the doomed Alliance vessel off the Wetlands.

The Intrepid was wrecked with the Third Fleet off the Wetlands, and its crew became restless, cursed spirits. Captain Halyndor watched over a mysterious item inside the ship’s heavy strongbox. Now his ghost prowls the waterlogged deck, still clutching the rusted key that opens it.
